intended_object: The restriction map res: Hⁿ_cts(G, X) → Hⁿ_cts(S, X|_S) in continuous group cohomology, for a subgroup S of a topological group G (with the subspace topology) and a topological G-representation X. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body is Mathlib's ContinuousCohomology.map applied to the compatible pair (inclusion S ↪ G as a continuous homomorphism, identity on the restricted coefficients). On cochains this sends σ to σ ∘ ι, i.e. restricting continuous cochains to S. That is exactly the standard restriction map. ContinuousMonoidHom.subgroupSubtype is S.subtype with continuity from continuous_subtype_val, so S gets the subspace topology, as it should. The definition works for an arbitrary subgroup of an arbitrary topological group and for topological representations over any topological ring, which is the natural generality and matches Mathlib's `map`. Mathlib has no separately named restriction map for continuous cohomology, only the general `map`.
